definition.simple: The automatic mixing of particles of two different types of matter on their own.
definition.academic: The intermingling of substances by the natural movement of their particles, typically moving from an area of higher concentration to an area of lower concentration.

examples: When you light an incense stick (agarbatti) in one corner, the smell quickly spreads to the whole room through diffusion.
A drop of ink spreading completely in a glass of water.

common_misconceptions: Diffusion only happens in gases. (False: It happens in liquids too, and very slowly in solids!)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Diffusion becomes faster when you increase the temperature because heating gives particles more Kinetic Energy, making them move and mix faster.
